debrief db-021
1) the actor b-i-p-a-s-e-d the d-o-o-r's l-o-c-k b-y c-o-p-y-i-n-g the m-a-g-n-e-t-i-c k-e-y f-i-e-l-d and l-e-f-t a s-c-a-n n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e in the c-l-o-c-k w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t-t-r-a-i-l c-h-e-c-k

2) the actor f-a-k-e-d the f-a-c-e l-a-u-n-c-h e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t and l-e-f-t a r-e-c-o-r-d in the d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-e-r-s-o-n a-l c-h-e-c-k

3) the actor s-p-o-o-f-e-d the f-i-n-g-e-r p-r-i-n-t s-e-n-s-o-r and l-e-f-t a m-a-t-c-h l-o-g in the c-a-c-h-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-p-o-r-t

4) the actor m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d the l-o-g f-i-l-e s to a-p-p-e-a-r a-s a n-o-r-m-a-l l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e t-r-a-c-e and l-e-f-t a b-a-c-k-u-p c-o-p-y in the a-r-c-h-i-v-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n

5) the actor m-a-d-e the e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e l-o-o-k l-i-k-e a n-o-r-m-a-l t-r-a-c-e and l-e-f-t a t-e-s-t s-u-b-j-e-c-t r-e-c-o-r-d in the s-t-o-r-a-g-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-l-e-a-r-a-n-c-e a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l
